# Framework Laptop 13 — Modular, Repairable Ultraportable (AMD Ryzen AI 300 Series)

**Category:** Laptop computer
**MSRP:** Starting at $849 (DIY Edition), $1,049 (pre-built)

## Tech Specs

| Spec | Detail |
|---|---|
| Release Year | 2025 |
| Processor options | Ryzen AI 5 340 (6c/12t, up to 4.8GHz); Ryzen AI 7 350 (8c/16t, up to 5.0GHz); Ryzen AI 9 HX 370 (12c/24t, up to 5.1GHz) |
| Processor Power | Performance: 30W sustained/35W boost; Balanced: 25W/33W; Efficiency: 15W/25W |
| NPU | Up to 50 TOPS |
| Integrated Graphics | Radeon 840M (4 cores, AI 5 340); Radeon 860M (8 cores, AI 7 350); Radeon 890M (16 cores, AI 9 HX 370) |
| Thermals | 65 x 5.5mm cooling fan, single 10mm heat pipe, Honeywell PTM7958 phase change thermal interface |
| Display Options | 2.2K: 13.5" 3:2, 2256x1504, >400nit, 60Hz, 100% sRGB, matte anti-glare — or — 2.8K: 13.5" 3:2, 2880x1920, >500nit, 120Hz, 100% sRGB, matte anti-glare |
| Memory | Up to 96GB DDR5-5600 (bring your own or buy from Framework) |

## Notable Features
- Fully modular: memory, storage, keyboard, bezel, and ports are all user-replaceable and sourced from the Framework Marketplace
- 4x Expansion Card slots let you mix and match USB-C, USB-A, HDMI, DisplayPort, Ethernet, card readers, and storage on the fly
- Rear two Expansion Card slots support full USB4 with DisplayPort output and USB-PD charging
- Strong Linux support with officially recommended distros and community guides
- Sustainability-focused build: majority recycled aluminum, recycled plastics, carbon-offset shipping
- Compact 13.5" 3:2 form factor with a choice of standard 2.2K 60Hz or high-res 2.8K 120Hz display
